about_the_game:
Operation: Michael Campaign DLC

Experience the opening strike of Germany’s final great offensive in the Operation: Michael Campaign DLC for Operation: Harsh Doorstop. Set during the historic Battle of Saint-Quentin in March 1918, this expansion puts you on the frontlines of one of World War I’s most ambitious and brutal operations.

Key Features:

  • ⚔️ Historical Battlefields:
    Battle across a detailed recreation of the Saint-Quentin sector, featuring trench networks, devastated towns, and strategic river crossings, all designed to reflect the real-world challenges of the 1918 offensive.

  • 🪖 Authentic Weapons and Factions:
    Deploy with accurate World War I-era gear, including bolt-action rifles, machine guns, artillery, and period-specific uniforms, as either German stormtroopers or Allied defenders.

  • 🎯 Exclusive Dynamic Campaign Mode:
    Fight for control of a shifting frontline in a dynamic campaign that reacts to player decisions and outcomes. Whether you're playing solo, in co-op, or in multiplayer, the battle evolves with every match.

Relive History. Rewrite the Outcome.

The Operation: Michael Campaign DLC brings a new level of historical immersion to Operation: Harsh Doorstop, challenging players to experience the scale and intensity of World War I’s most daring offensive. Rally your squad, secure the line, and push the enemy back—Saint-Quentin awaits.
